question: Contá los fármacos distintos que se prueban en ensayos clínicos de mieloma múltiple.

attempts.query:
WITH farmacos AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.chembl_id, m.pref_name
  FROM chembl.molecule_dictionary m
  WHERE m.pref_name IS NOT NULL AND m.chembl_id = COALESCE(m.parent_chembl_id, m.chembl_id)
),
nombres AS (
  SELECT i.nct_id, lower(i.name) AS nombre FROM aact.interventions i
  UNION
  SELECT o.nct_id, lower(o.name) FROM aact.intervention_other_names o
)
SELECT count(DISTINCT f.chembl_id)
FROM nombres n
JOIN farmacos f ON n.nombre LIKE '%' || lower(f.pref_name) || '%'
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM aact.browse_conditions bc
              WHERE bc.nct_id = n.nct_id AND bc.downcase_mesh_term = 'multiple myeloma')
